home.title: Backend Developer & Software Architect
home.bio: With over 9 years of experience, I specialize in building robust, scalable, and high-availability software systems. My primary focus is on the backend, using technologies like .NET and PHP to create secure and efficient solutions. I am passionate about clean architecture design, database optimization, and implementing agile methodologies to deliver quality products.
